scientific_integrity: All claims concern a specified independent-Poisson two-sex initial quorum. Proof is analytic; finite diagnostics are supplementary. No independent audit or empirical validation. No claim of historical uniqueness from search alone.
scientific_limitations: Initial quorum feasibility, not long-term persistence
Independent homogeneous Poisson founder arrivals and complete mixing
Unlimited male service capacity and specified integer female quorum
No stability, density dependence, sex-specific costs or measurement error analysis
Inaccessible potentially relevant broad reliability full text and possible historical priority overlap
title: A Poisson founding-quorum sex-allocation law with a monotone budget response
